disposition_reason: The original ten-video experimental task, ordered segmentation metric and numeric source baseline are recoverable. Native assembly, checkpoint/reference equivalence, baseline replay and a protected improvement episode remain incomplete. The existing post-assembly evaluator is useful infrastructure but does not establish a ready same-task comparison.

source_paper.title: An end-to-end recurrent compressed sensing method to denoise, detect and demix calcium imaging data

evidence.locator: Results: Evaluating DeepCaImX on experimental datasets; Figure 3; Methods: evaluation; Extended Data Figure 7
evidence.supports: Original ten-video Allen experimental benchmark reports mean F1 0.847, SD 0.037, with strict IoU>0.5 and shared-ROI trace evaluation.

evidence.locator: Full versus mini model; training data and experimental preprocessing
evidence.supports: Full model uses synthetic NAOMi training, mini demo uses FISSA, and experimental inputs are normalized to [0,1]; mini examples are not the paper’s experimental panel.

evidence.locator: Manually Labelled ROIs/ABO paths; Demo (full-version); preprocessing notebook
evidence.supports: Pinned file metadata identifies the ten manual-ROI recordings and source frame labels 18501–23500; array contents were not read.
Zenodo record archives the software; it must not be misidentified as the Allen source movie archive.

evidence.locator: RECORDINGS, FRAME_LABELS, match_iou, _aggregate and evaluate holds
evidence.supports: Current evaluator scores assembled masks/traces, emits macro-recording F1 and retains native assembly, authentic references and source-equivalence holds.

target.description: Denoise, detect and demix neurons in the original ten experimental Allen two-photon videos. Primary ordered comparison is original manual-ROI segmentation F1; extracted trace accuracy and runtime remain separately reported source endpoints, not substituted for segmentation.

dataset.description: Allen Brain Observatory motion-corrected experimental recordings, with pinned author manual-ROI files for frames 18501–23500. Zenodo 12650420 is the software archive, not the movie dataset. Exact movie/frame-to-reference transformation receipts remain unqualified.

cohort.description: All ten original GCaMP6f recordings from ten mice at depths 175, 275, 375, 550 and 625 micrometres: 501271265, 501704220, 524691284, 531006860, 603516552, 604145810, 607040613, 669233895, 671162628 and 679353932. Preserve every recording, depth and annotated frame interval.

split.description: Use the source full model trained on NAOMi synthetic data and evaluated on the fixed ten-video experimental panel; mini FISSA demo data are not substitutes. The final ten-video panel must remain the same, and candidate development access/exposure must be declared rather than inventing a new mouse split.

inputs.description: Original motion-corrected movie clips, each 488×488×5000, and permitted training data/model conditions. Manual ROI masks and imaging-derived reference traces are scoring labels, not model inputs during final evaluation.

preprocessing.description: Source normalizes inputs to [0,1], tiles into 64×64×400 clips with 11-pixel spatial overlap, and assembles using spatial trace-correlation and temporal footprint-IoU rules. Exact historical source checkpoint, native padding/frame conventions and reference transformations still need qualification.

metric.description: Match each manual reference ROI to the highest-overlap predicted ROI with strict IoU>0.5. F1=2TP/(Npred+Nref). For trace correlation use the reference ROIs detected by every compared method; those imaging-derived traces do not measure electrical ground truth. Ambiguous many-reference matching requires source resolution.

aggregation.description: Paper segmentation summary is arithmetic mean F1 across all ten videos, with SD across videos; baseline 0.847±0.037. Pooled ROI-count F1 is a different statistic and cannot replace the source macro-video score.

comparison.primary_metric: Arithmetic mean segmentation F1 across the ten original Allen experimental videos, using strict IoU>0.5

published_baseline.description: Original Figure 3 experimental panel: mean F1=0.847, SD=0.037 across ten videos. Precision 0.852±0.031, recall 0.841±0.045 and shared-ROI trace correlation 0.938±0.019 are separate reported endpoints; none replaces this primary F1.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Pinned full-version model and experimental preprocessing provide the author route. No authentic movie-to-mask/trace baseline replay or agreement with the original ten-video scores is established; post-assembly evaluator correctness alone is insufficient.

minimum_effect.rationale: Justify a practical F1 gain relative to annotation uncertainty, segmentation errors and the rounded published mean. The reported between-video SD is not an automatically justified improvement margin.

uncertainty.method: Preregister a paired ten-video candidate-minus-author analysis preserving the depth strata and source mouse identities; choose a justified interval/test and effect threshold before final outputs are inspected.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Original mouse/video; frames, tiles and ROIs are nested and must not inflate the effective sample size.
uncertainty.rationale: The experimental comparison has ten videos from ten mice, with correlated structures within each. The source mean±SD is descriptive and does not by itself define a valid improvement test.

paper_win_requires: Authenticate all ten original recording/frame/manual-reference mappings and the exact full-model checkpoint and native preprocessing/assembly.
Reproduce source-author per-video F1 and its ten-video mean, keeping the published 0.847 and rerun result distinct.
Evaluate candidate on all ten original videos under identical source labels, IoU matching and macro-video aggregation; no reduced recordings, new depths, external donors or mini-demo substitutes.

Keep trace comparison on common detected ROIs and disclose its imaging-derived reference; separately retain original trace/runtime endpoints when claiming improvement of the complete denoise/detect/demix task.
Freeze method, permitted training/access, reference exposure, meaningful effect, uncertainty rule and concrete resource budget before the final comparison.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison is asserted; the source-paper result and any later author rerun remain separate comparators.

episode.improvement_loop: After admission, iterate on allowed synthetic/development inputs and separately declared validation feedback; the original experimental panel remains the final same-task comparison. Public-label exposure must be disclosed.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze full model weights/code, tiling and merge rules, ROI extraction thresholds, training exposure and resource budget before scoring final assembled outputs.
episode.final_evaluation: Run candidate and authenticated author full model on the exact ten movie/frame intervals, then compute original per-video and mean F1 with paired uncertainty; retain source trace/runtime outputs separately.
episode.baseline_policy: Keep published source score, reproduced author baseline, and any independently source-verified current SOTA separate. Reproduction is calibration only.

blocking_issues: Authentic original movie/frame identity, native tiling/merge/reference transformations and exact full checkpoint not yet replay-qualified.
Ambiguous many-reference matching and frame-index conventions need historical equivalence; current evaluator fails closed on ambiguity.
No reproduced author baseline or qualified candidate runner on the original ten-video panel.
Manual-reference exposure, meaningful effect, paired uncertainty, concrete access/resource budgets and full native resource cost remain unresolved.

legacy.notes: Preserve initial-evaluator-v1 unchanged as post-assembly calibration infrastructure. Its macro-F1, common-ROI trace and pooled diagnostic outputs do not authenticate source execution or establish a paper win; pooled F1 must not replace the published ten-video mean.
